title: MSP Tool Stack Design & Standup — PSA, RMM & Patch Management
author_notes: Derived from a Microsoft Cloud Solution Architect (MSP) requirement: design, configure, manage, and support the internal MSP tool stack (PSA, RMM, patch management).

Scope: design + stand up + integrate the core MSP platform stack (PSA, RMM, patch) with a repeatable client-onboarding workflow and operating standards. Vendor-agnostic with named examples; vendor-specific console clicks deferred to the chosen products' docs. White-label.
pricing: T5 (enterprise program) — multi-platform standup + integration + onboarding, the practice-wide foundation.
